description: Dynamic Island for Windows with Native Media, System Monitor, and AI Companion Hub (Antigravity & Claude Code)

userStories.title: Core Frameless Island Window & Smooth Animation Engine

QPropertyAnimation with smooth spring/easing curve for state transitions

userStories.title: Compact Idle Pill with Clock, Battery, and Pulsating AI Glow
